what_it_does: On massive supercomputers like El Capitan (over 1 million CPU cores and 10,000 GPUs), operating system services (file I/O, memory management, scheduling) interfere with user applications, causing unpredictable slowdowns. This paper identifies and fixes the problem by isolating system services away from applications using system-level configuration tools, and provides a step-by-step tuning guide that works across different Linux distributions.
